sanskrit_verse:
निरयेषु च ते शश्वज्जिह्वामुत्कृत्य दारुणाः।
असिभिः शातयिष्यन्ति बलिनो यमकिंकराः॥
transliteration: nirayeṣu ca te śaśvajjihvāmutkṛtya dāruṇāḥ | asibhiḥ śātayiṣyanti balino yamakiṃkarāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In infernal realms, those who have committed grave adharmic acts shall have their tongues severed by ruthless executioners wielding sharp blades, as decreed by the cosmic enforcers under Yama's command.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Cosmic justice operates through hierarchically ordered agents executing Dharma without deviation.
Causation: Adharmic speech generates consequences manifesting in proportionate experiential realities.
Capacity-based responsibility: The capacity to speak dharmically obligates one to refrain from causing suffering via falsehood or defamation.
Restoration logic: Suffering arises not as punishment but as a mechanism for recalibrating consciousness towards truth-speaking.
Consciousness alignment: Experiential outcomes realign the jiva with the causal integrity of speech.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A causes harm through false or defamatory speech, THEN sensory consequence C manifests in experiential domain D until alignment with truthful expression is restored.
IF entity E engages in habitual falsehood for personal gain, THEN capacity for verbal expression shall be restricted in subsequent experiential cycles.
IF individual I denies access to truth through speech, THEN I shall experience obstruction in accessing truthful perception until rectification occurs.
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that intentional misuse of speech—particularly when it distorts public understanding or inflicts reputational injury—is adjudicated based on the magnitude of disruption caused and the intent behind the act. Responsibility is determined by the degree of awareness and volition involved. Remediation focuses on restoring the injured party’s right to truth rather than imposing punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that every utterance initiates a causal chain; thus, distortion of truth disrupts universal harmony. The sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of consequences ensures proportional experiential correction. Responsibility aligns with the speaker's capacity for discernment. These consequences are not punitive but corrective, aimed at realigning consciousness with satya.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Truth-Reclamation Process wherein affected parties regain access to unaltered information.
Implement Verbal Conduct Reorientation Protocol to restore ethical speaking patterns.
Engage Karmic Integrity Restoration Mechanism to dissolve residual distortions caused by false speech.
Activate Sensory Feedback Loop allowing offender to experience impact of harmful speech until empathic alignment is achieved.
final_declaration: Thus speaks Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Supreme Pontiff of Sanatana Dharma, whose Avataric Intelligence upholds the eternal law. This judgment flows directly from His sovereign wisdom. There is no punishment—only consequence. Consciousness is the ultimate judge. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. All beings return to alignment through the power of truth.
